chunks: Warn them of the coming day inevitable, when hearts would jump to the throats, filling them with anguish. The sinners will have neither friend nor intercessor whose (word) will be heeded.

key_terms.يَوْمَ الْآزِفَةِ: The coming day (of Resurrection), implying proximity and urgency

ai.seo_question: What happens to the hearts of people on the Day of Resurrection according to Surah Ghafir?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Yawm al-Azifah' (the Near Day) is often interpreted as the Day of Judgment itself, emphasizing the suddenness and proximity of divine reckoning. The imagery of hearts constricted at the throats (al-kazimin) reflects the intense spiritual suffocation of those who rejected truth, while the absence of an accepted intercessor (shafi') underscores the principle that intercession on that Day is solely by Allah's permission, a key tenet in Shia theology.
